messages:
maria: Heads-up — we got a reply from OpenWeights team about licensing for the model bundle they want us to onboard. They sent a draft redistribution clause and a marketplace addendum. Sharing their note: https://openweights.example/license-draft

ben: Thanks. Can you paste the exact redistribution paragraph here? need to check compatibility with our distro & marketplace TOS.

maria: Sure, pasted below:```Redistribution: Recipient may distribute model weights and derivative works subject to attribution and non-commercial use only. Any commercial use requires a separate commercial license agreed with Licensor.```

tia: Non-commercial only is a red flag for us. We need clear permission to host in hosted API and Dedicated for paying customers. does their "commercial license" path look feasible?

ben: Agreed — as-is it prevents us from providing the model through our paid Hosted API or Dedicated product. Options: 1) ask for an explicit commercial sublicense to Redwood for marketplace/resale, or 2) get a dual-license where weights are available under permissive terms for server-side commercial use.

sam: From product/marketplace perspective we need either sublicensing or a specific carve-out that allows: "Hosting, serving, and billing for paying users as part of Redwood Inference services." That language is standard in previous marketplace deals.

oliver: Also confirm export control and origin-of-data warranties. Some partners want to limit gov usage or require end-customer attestations which complicates onboarding. Any nuance in their addendum?

maria: Their addendum includes a clause about "prohibited end uses" but it's generic. They didn't include sublicensing language. They did offer co-marketing for launch and a revenue share proposal (20%).

ben: Revenue share OK but subordinate. Primary legal ask: require sublicensing right for Redwood to provide the model to our customers and to list it on cloud marketplaces (AWS/GCP/Azure). Suggest language:```Licensor hereby grants to Redwood a worldwide, non-exclusive, transferable, sublicensable license to reproduce, distribute, host, and make available the Model and derivative works for commercial purposes including SaaS, hosted API, and marketplace listing.```

tia: Technically, we'll also need permission to load/convert weights into our quantized formats and redistribute those artifacts to Dedicated customers (who get the binaries). Add "create optimized/quantized builds for serving" to the rights list.

maria: Good call. I'll propose adding: "including the right to create and distribute optimized or quantized versions for inference."

sam: On listing flow: we'll need logos, a product description, 1-2 example benchmarks, chip/hardware guidance, and a launch calendar. If legal can sign off on sublicensing and quantization rights, I'll coordinate the marketplace asset checklist.

ben: One more: indemnity and warranty terms. If their model has third-party data claims or copyleft components (e.g., a portion under GPL), we need reps/warranties that they have the rights to grant the license. Ask for a representation: "Licensor represents that it has all rights necessary to grant the above license and that the Model does not contain components that would require us to open-source Redwood products or artifacts."

oliver: Also ask about preferred launch messaging and whether they want the "Redwood-verified" performance badge. That affects our QA/benchmarking commitments.

integrations-bot: (automated) added checklist item: legal-sublicense, quantization-rights, rep-warranty, marketplace-assets to partnerships Jira #PART-4827

maria: Action items then: 1) I will send a counter-draft to their legal with sublicensing + quantization + rep/warranty + export control carve-outs. 2) ben — can you draft the exact clause for sublicensing and the rep language? 3) sam/oliver — prepare marketplace requirements and a tentative GTM timeline for when we can accept a 20% rev share.

ben: I'll draft the clause and post in this thread by EOD Pacific.

sam: I'll throw together the asset checklist and a 6-week launch plan; posting a link in a.m.

maria: Great — pinging @tia for any red flags on model artifacts format once we get their weights. thanks all :thumbsup:
